headline: Nigeria Customs Generates N1.42 Trillion and $752.8M in Exports
summary: The Nigeria Customs Service reported generating more than N1.42 trillion in revenue in September and October, alongside $752.8 million in exports during the third quarter of 2026.
why: Customs revenue and export figures serve as key indicators of national trade activity, fiscal inflows, and macroeconomic performance.
